The Micromeritics AccuPyc gas pycnometer is globally recognized for delivering the most dependable measurements of true density. It is the preferred choice in laboratories worldwide, surpassing other commercial gas pycnometers. The AccuPyc provides unmatched accuracy and repeatability, all within a user-friendly and efficient system that appeals to operators of any skill level.
Highlights and Features
Gas Pycnometer for True Density of Solids
Not Just Fast, The Fastest
A system with increased stability, faster equilibration, and enhanced gas exchange, resulting in reduced runtime. Achieve full measurements in 20 % to 30 % less time compared to alternative pycnometers.
Not Just Accurate, The Most Accurate
Each aspect of the AccuPyc design contributes to improved accuracy and minimized variability, featuring the most stable temperature control, advanced gas modeling, highly repeatable lid closure, and other enhancements. Achieve superior measurements for reliable and trustworthy results.
Image Credit: Micromeritics Instrument Corporation
Not Just Easy, The Easiest
A hinged, self-aligning lid ensures effortless and error-free operation for every user. Simply swing, turn, and it is done. Coupled with an intuitive control and display system, the AccuPyc stands as the simplest instrument users will ever integrate into their laboratory.
Image Credit: Micromeritics Instrument Corporation
The Widest Range of Measurement Temperatures
Achieve precision control within the temperature range of 4 °C to 60 °C, allowing you to measure density under conditions tailored to your process. AccuTemp, a noiseless and air-cooled thermoelectric temperature control system, facilitates this flexibility.
Image Credit: Micromeritics Instrument Corporation
The Same Results Anytime, Any Place With Accutemp
Each AccuPyc is equipped with AccuTemp, ensuring temperature stability to ±0.025 °C or superior. This unparalleled temperature stability guarantees the most repeatable and reliable density measurements with every use.
Image Credit: Micromeritics Instrument Corporation
Unparalleled Measurement Gas Flexibility
Effortlessly determine solid density with nitrogen, air, argon, and other gases without the need for extra steps, calibrations, or compromises. Leveraging advanced technology validated in Micromeritics' top-tier gas adsorption instruments, you can seamlessly switch gases and conserve helium when testing materials that are non-microporous and non-adsorbing.
Powder Safe Is Worry-Free
Ensure the safety of both your sample and instrument while testing fluffy, lightweight powders with PowderSafe mode. Pressurizing the reference chamber before the sample chamber removes the risk of elutriation during the measurement of fine powders. Simply choose this mode in your saved method and bid farewell to any concerns.
Image Credit: Micromeritics Instrument Corporation
Run, Review, Report–At Users’ Fingertips
The user-friendly Breeze touch interface puts everything you need right at your fingertips. Conduct measurements, review previous results, and send reports for printing or to LIMS with a simple touch. Streamline your laboratory space by removing the need for a PC on the bench.
Act as One With Mic Net
Never worry if the method settings are outdated or try to find a previous result. An instrument-to-instrument network called MIC NET stores and exchanges data between instruments, including forward compatibility with the AccuPyc currently in use in the laboratory. 
Image Credit: Micromeritics Instrument Corporation
Measure Right, Without Questions
Light powders, granules, foams, or slurries all require different operating conditions. Establish the right conditions for your procedure and record them in the Method Library. Remember the next time you need it so you always measure the same way - that is, the right way.
Image Credit: Micromeritics Instrument Corporation
Seamless Device Connectivity
Streamline your workflow and minimize transcription errors by directly connecting your laboratory balance to the AccuPyc via a USB connection. Transmit sample mass directly, eliminating a manual step and reducing the risk of user errors.
Additionally, the AccuPyc integrates seamlessly with other laboratory input devices, such as a keyboard or barcode reader, to further streamline user interaction.
Image Credit: Micromeritics Instrument Corporation
Ultimate Volume Flexibility
The AccuPyc maintains accuracy and simplicity while accommodating a diverse range of measurement volumes through the use of straightforward volume insert kits.
Image Credit: Micromeritics Instrument Corporation
FOAMPYC
The FoamPyc methods adhere to ASTM and ISO standards for evaluating open and closed cell content, compressibility, and cell fracture with mechanically and chemically formed cellular polymers like PVC, polystyrene, and polyurethane.
Scarce Samples
Minimize measurement volume to conserve precious resources.
Heterogeneous Materials or Large Pieces
Utilize a high volume to guarantee a representative measurement.
